## Background

## Intro research question/analysis

```{r}
# Initialize libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(tmap)
library(lubridate)
library(here)
```

## Read data
```{r}
# Read states data
states <- st_read(here("data", "tl_2020_us_state","tl_2020_us_state.shp")) |> 
    st_transform(crs="EPSG:4326")
```

```{r}
# Read Journey North monarch observations
monarchs <- read_csv(here("data", "UWMadisonArb_JNorth_Project_MonarchsAndMilkweed_1996-2020.csv")) |> 
    filter(stringr::str_detect(species, "Monarch")) |> 
    drop_na(latitude, longitude) |> 
    mutate(year = year(sighting_date)) |> 
    mutate(dayofyear = yday(sighting_date)) |> 
    st_as_sf(coords = c('longitude', 'latitude'), crs = 4326)
```

```{r}
# Read Culbertsonetal Cape May Monarch Data
cape_may_monarchs <- readxl::read_excel(here("data", "Culbertsonetal_MonarchMigration_RawData.xls"), sheet="AllData") |> 
    mutate(dayofyear = yday(date))
head(cape_may_monarchs)
```

## Analysis

### Plot midpoint migration for Cape May Observations
```{r}
cape_may_summ <- cape_may_monarchs |> 
    summarize(total_count = sum(count, na.rm=TRUE), .by = year) |> 
    mutate(mid_point_count = total_count / 2)

mid_point_migration_obs <- cape_may_monarchs |> 
    left_join(cape_may_summ, by = "year") |> 
    group_by(year) |> 
    mutate(cum_count = cumsum(count)) |> 
    filter(cum_count >= mid_point_count) |> # Find date where half of monarchs have migrated
    slice_head(n=1)

ggplot(mid_point_migration_obs,
    aes(x=year, y=dayofyear)) +
        geom_point() +
        labs(title="Migration Midpoint over the years - Cape May Station")
```
